headline: Indian markets face muted global cues, rising crude oil, and soaring US yields amid an active IPO week.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rising oil prices and climbing US yields are fueling interest rate hike concerns globally.
Bulls have lost steam on D-Street as Indian equities remain stuck in a grind.
Geopolitical tension and high crude prices continue to offset value buying.
Emerging market investors are shunning riskier bonds due to soaring US treasury yields.
whatHappening: A major IPO rush continues with 20 issues aiming to raise over Rs 1,257 crore this week.
Asian markets remain subdued amid rate hike concerns and global macroeconomic triggers.
IRDAI is considering regulatory changes regarding how insurance products are sold.
Key equities including Adani Power, SAIL, and Cupid are in focus for today's session.
summary:
Indian stock markets face muted global cues amidst rising crude oil prices and soaring US yields.
The primary market remains hyperactive with 20 IPO issues set to raise over Rs 1,257 crore this week.
Key individual stocks under news focus today include Adani Power, SAIL, and Cupid.
